papers.title: OmniCAD: A Large-Scale Benchmark for 3D Spatial Reasoning in Robotics Assemblies
papers.title_zh: OmniCAD：面向机器人装配中3D空间推理的大规模基准
papers.tldr_zh: OmniCAD是首个大规模工业装配3D空间推理基准，揭示VLM在此任务上的不足。
papers.cover_zh: VLM在工业装配推理上翻车？OmniCAD基准揭示其短板，你敢来挑战吗？
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的视觉语言模型（VLM）在机器人感知和空间推理方面表现出强大的能力，但它们在复杂机械装配推理方面的能力仍未得到充分探索。我们引入了OmniCAD，这是一个面向装配感知的3D空间推理的大规模基准，涵盖多种工业系统，包括机器人机构、汽车零部件、航空航天结构和农业机械。OmniCAD包含25,000个机械装配体，每个装配体平均有12个零件和21种配合关系。每个装配体都包含人工验证的真实3D模型和来自20个视角的渲染图。该基准评估三种能力：（1）组件级3D空间推理，要求预测零件的位置和方向；（2）零件间关系推理，要求识别配合关系和装配约束；（3）工具增强的代理推理，模型迭代选择视角、检查视觉证据并细化预测。实验表明，当前的VLM在工业装配推理方面表现不佳，经常产生不准确的姿态、无效的配合关系、零件相互穿透，并且随着装配复杂度的增加性能下降。我们将开源基准、评估代码和工具接口，以支持准确、物理有效且可扩展的3D装配推理研究。

judge.reason: 大规模3D空间推理基准，面向机器人装配，评估VLM能力，对具身操作研究有高价值。

papers.title: DreamMimic: Learning Visuomotor Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation via World Model
papers.title_zh: DreamMimic: Learning Visuomotor Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation via World Model
papers.tldr_zh: Vision-based whole-body loco-manipulation on humanoid robots
papers.cover_zh: Vision-based whole-body loco-manipulation on humanoid robots
papers.abstract_zh: Vision-based whole-body loco-manipulation on humanoid robots is challenging due to partial observability, contact-rich dynamics, and the difficulty of learning long-horizon behaviors from high-dimensional visual inputs. We present href{https://github.com/DreamMimic/DreamMimic}{DreamMimic}, a framework that distills privileged teacher policies into vision-based humanoid controllers via world-model-assisted distillation. Instead of using a Dreamer-style RSSM for planning, we repurpose it to learn predictive latent dynamics that serve as both a representation space and an action-conditioned multi-step supervision signal, while exposing compact predictive features to the student policy to reduce long-term drift. Beyond standard reconstruction objectives for proprioceptive and visual observations, we add auxiliary prediction heads for privileged state, contact, object state, and reward estimation. These heads provide additional supervision related to agent--object interaction and task progress, encouraging the latent representation to retain signals that are useful for contact-rich loco-manipulation. We further introduce Performance-Conditioned Guidance (PCG), a reward-driven adaptive distillation schedule that computes performance scores for both teacher and student to dynamically balance guidance and exploration. PCG prevents both premature teacher annealing and excessive teacher interference in challenging visual settings. Experiments on OMOMO and BEHAVE show improved tracking-based loco-manipulation performance over strong vision-based baselines, without exposing online privileged interaction states to the student at deployment. Qualitative simulations further examine morphology and simulator changes. These results suggest that world models can provide a useful mechanism for stabilizing visual policy distillation in contact-rich humanoid behaviors.

papers.title: Enhancing Sim2Real Transfer for Torque-Controlled Robots through Real2Sim Dynamics Estimation and Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: 通过Real2Sim动力学估计与强化学习增强扭矩控制机器人的Sim2Real迁移
papers.tldr_zh: 提出Real2Sim2Real流程，通过动力学校准提升扭矩控制机器人的策略迁移效果。
papers.cover_zh: 仿真到现实不再翻车｜扭矩控制机器人靠动力学校准实现平滑迁移
papers.abstract_zh: 将强化学习策略从仿真迁移到真实世界机器人仍然是一个重大挑战，尤其是在处理低级扭矩控制时，即使是微小的建模误差也可能导致不稳定或不安全的行为。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种Real2Sim2Real流程，通过结合轨迹匹配、基于遗传算法的参数优化和域随机化，改善了扭矩控制机械臂的Sim2Real迁移。使用7自由度Franka Emika Panda机器人，我们首先通过最小化真实与仿真关节轨迹之间的误差来识别摩擦、惯性和重力补偿参数。然后，这些校准后的动力学参数被用于在仿真中训练基于TQC的强化学习智能体。训练后的策略在Gazebo和MuJoCo环境中进行评估，并最终部署到真实机器人上。我们的结果表明，在参数调整后，跟踪精度和策略鲁棒性显著提高，并且在多个目标到达任务中，策略从仿真到真实世界的迁移平滑。这项工作强调了精确物理建模在实现稳定且可泛化的基于扭矩的强化学习策略中的有效性。

judge.reason: 提出Real2Sim2Real管道，结合动力学辨识与域随机化提升扭矩控制机器人的Sim2Real迁移，方法实用但创新性一般。
